alt: 說話者誇張地指著枝上的小蜘蛛，頭上浮現巨大蜘蛛的想像畫面，聽者驚慌後退。
scene_prompt: A boastful adult on a park path points theatrically at a tiny harmless spider on a twig. An imaginary pale cloud vignette above the speaker shows the SAME spider exaggerated as a huge threatening monster. Two listeners recoil fearfully; the actual tiny spider remains peacefully visible beside a relaxed bird. Make the exaggerated story visibly contradict reality, no words or symbols.
